sections.text:
Ability Power 200. Damages all enemies 3 times with physical fire damage with a success value of 100.
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Casts a 50% damage reflection barrier on all allies for 40 seconds.
-Locks wind Unison attacks from all enemies for 120 seconds.
-Casts karma on all enemies.
-Stuns all enemies with a success value of 80.
-Increases the Unison gauge gains of all allies by 3 for 50 seconds.
-Casts awakening on your character.
-Damages your character for 40% of your current HP.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 7000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 7000
